description: A country hosts one or more leagues and a league cannot exist without its host country. Country is the whole, League the component.
A league is composed of the matches played in it; a match cannot exist outside a league. 11 leagues hold between 1422 and 3040 matches each.

connection_condition: Match.season carries the season text for the match
description: A season is composed of the matches played in it; the eight season values partition the whole Match table.

connection_condition: Match.stage carries the round number of the match within its season
description: A round is composed of the matches played in that round; rounds run from 1 to 38 within a season.
A match is composed of exactly two team participations, one per venue role; a match cannot exist without both sides.

connection_condition: indirect: a player is linked to a team only through the 22 lineup columns of the matches he appeared in, since no roster or contract table exists
description: A team fields players, but the database records the association only per match rather than as a persistent squad membership. Aggregating a player's team must go through the lineup columns.

connection_condition: each payload column root holds one <value> element per incident
description: The event feed is composed of individual match events; removing the feed removes the events. The feed exists as a whole or not at all for a match.
A goal event is a kind of match event, discriminated by the payload root being the goal column and by the goal_type element.
A card event is a kind of match event, discriminated by the payload root being the card column and by the card_type element.
A possession snapshot is a kind of match event, discriminated by the payload root being the possession column and by the subtype element.
The match outcome is derived by comparing the goals scored by one side with the goals scored by the other; the two scoreline columns are the only inputs.
Goal difference is derived as goals scored minus goals conceded over a chosen match set for a reference team.
League points are derived by mapping each per-match outcome to a points value under the competition convention and summing within a league and season.
Player age is derived from the date of birth together with an explicit reference date.
Potential and overall rating are two FIFA ability scores carried on the same snapshot row. Potential is a ceiling forecast and is not computed from the current rating.
Work rate and overall rating are attributes of the same player snapshot row and are frequently analysed together when profiling players.

connection_condition: both are H/D/A decimal price triples for the same match row
description: Bet365 and Pinnacle prices express the same business concept, the pre-match 1X2 market price of a match, from two different providers. Their availability windows differ, so either can substitute for the other but not everywhere.
The implied outcome probabilities are derived by inverting each decimal price of a bookmaker family and normalising the three across the match.
Shots on target are derived by counting the qualifying shot events inside the shoton payload; the feed is the only source.
The card count is derived by counting card events and splitting them by card_type.
Possession share is derived from the homepos and awaypos values of the possession snapshots, taking the final snapshot for a match-level figure.
A player is composed of his dated ability snapshots; a snapshot cannot exist without its player. 183978 snapshots cover 11060 players.
A team is composed of its dated tactical snapshots; a snapshot cannot exist without its team. Only 288 of 299 teams have any snapshot.

connection_condition: both keys are carried on the same Player row and on the same Player_Attributes row
description: The two player keys identify the same real people but have disjoint value domains, so one cannot be substituted for the other. Only player_api_id is referenced by the match lineup columns.

connection_condition: both keys are carried on the same Team row and on the same Team_Attributes row
description: The two team keys identify the same clubs but have disjoint value domains. Only team_api_id is referenced by the match columns.

connection_condition: indirect: the country label is reached from a league only by joining League.country_id to Country.id
description: A country label is attached to every league, but League stores no country name of its own, so the label must be resolved through the Country table.
